provider: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (MCGM) / Esri India service credits
terms: Service metadata does not state a reuse license for these records. User will review source permissions before external publication. Local snapshot is retained for development.
scope_notes: The flooding-spots records do not expose a verified flood-event date. Record creation and edit dates are not treated as event dates.
19 of the 34 F/S flood-record names contain a deletion marker; records are preserved and labeled, not silently removed.
The exposed temporary-shelter schema does not provide verified capacity or current operating status.
schema_notes: Flooding Spots metadata aliases DEPTH only as Depth and provides no measurement unit; HEIGHT_TO_MSL is empty in all 34 F/S records.
Flooding Spots has coded SUBTYPE values for localized flooding, remedial measures done/in progress/not possible, and others. Record creation/edit timestamps are not event dates.
Flooding Spots AFFECT_POPULATION is populated in 13 of 34 records; values are source estimates/attributes with no reference date or deduplication method, so do not sum as a ward population impact.

Temporary Shelters metadata includes staff/equipment and working-hours fields, but no shelter capacity or current-operation status field. All F/S working-hour fields are null in the retrieved snapshot.
